messages:
kai: quick drop — Herbie the hamster built a sundial out of a cereal box and a toothpick. photos + 3s boomerang: https://imgur.com/herbie_sundial
rachel: wait he understands time? :eyes: 
omar: that's it. he's promoted to Chief Time Officer :tophat: 
zuri: that boomerang is the exact moment of pride when he chucked a cracker and it ricocheted into the corner :joy: 
stacey: can we standardize his timezone? PST? GMT? I vote PST so he overlaps with west coasters for snack handoffs :coffee: 
kai: poll: Should Herbie get a tiny sundial sign that says "Do Not Disturb (unless treats)"? :thumbsup: yes :thumbsdown: no 
rachel: :thumbsup: 
omar: :thumbsup: 
zuri: :thumbsup: 
kai: 3/3 
stacey: also lowkey petition to replace the standup timer with Herbie running in his little wheel. thoughts? 
omar: only if HR signs the pet schedule. and someone volunteers as the official wheel-operator :raised_hands: 
lunchbot: Reminder: To bring pets into the office, please complete the pet registry and scheduled visit slot: https://intranet/fw/pet-policy. Allergies? Check the shared doc: https://intranet/fw/allergy-list 
zuri: noted! i'll add a "Herbie shift" column to the corkboard calendar. tiny costume suggestions: minuscule sundial cape, or a tiny magistrate wig. 
stacey: cape wins. he looks like a medieval watchmaker. 
kai: (owner) cape it is. Launching a #herbie-feed channel in 2 weeks for ongoing sundial science updates :camera_with_flash:
